name: Chris & Cosey
description:
'''Chris & Cosey''', sometimes known as '''Carter Tutti''', are an English musical duo formed in 1981, consisting of [[Chris Carter (British musician)|Chris Carter]] (electronics) and [[Cosey Fanni Tutti]] (voice, electronics, guitar, cornet). They founded the duo after the breakup of their earlier group [[Throbbing Gristle]]. 

Since the release of their 1981 debut album ''Heartbeat'', Chris & Cosey have expanded on the rhythmic ideas of Throbbing Gristle while adding synthesized pop elements to the harsh [[industrial music]] of Throbbing Gristle.
